# Templates

Empty tables to start our Assessment 1 documents. Copy them into the shared document
(Google Docs / Word) and fill them in there. The content is ours to write.

Remember the formatting rules for every PDF: sans-serif 11pt, single line spacing,
margins of at least 1 cm, cover page with names only (no exam numbers).

---

## Req1: requirements tables

Priorities: **Shall** = must have · **Should** = important · **May** = nice to have.
Sources: the product brief, or the client meeting (`docs/meetings/2026-10-14-client-meeting-notes.md`).
